name: Rake
summary: A boastful social rogue who trades sneak attack damage for intimidation and cultivates a winning smile.

features.name: Bravado's Blade
features.summary: For each 1d6 sneak attack damage forgone, demoralize the struck foe and gain +5 on the Intimidate check.

features.name: Rake's Smile
features.summary: Gain +1 morale on Bluff and Diplomacy.
